subject: [hw] J02 -> IP: one-line follow-up (do not glob rwjpeg_tool.c into the plug-in)
body:
Follow-up to my integration proposal: add exactly gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/rwjpeg.c and gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/n2jpeg_hw_vt.c to Slim.videoencoder. Do NOT glob gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/*.c: rwjpeg_tool.c has main() and is a separate executable for the phone test. (It would link harmlessly with -fvisibility=hidden, but it pulls /dev/console logging and the selftest into every media process.) The tool is built separately with the same rwjpeg.c; on iOS it needs only libSystem.
Also, my acceptance compile check used the gpu/video/build_ios.sh flag set with -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec/jpeg and -nostdinc; all three objects compile with zero warnings. If your build script differs, send the command and I will re-run it.
